entries.description: The unchanged original executable reproduces every field of the original inner true-residual failure; evidence-attribution audit passed, native evaluation failed.
Source inventory keys retained a source/ prefix while the comparison used paths below source/. No compilation occurred.
The expected base was the repository extension; the installed native header includes the existing segmented export hook. The guard rejected the mismatch before compilation.
The read-only capture-build namespace binding was missing. No native evaluation or worker output occurred. Local capture03 names refer to remote telemetry01.
The separately compiled capture binary and reader reproduce the exact original failure. Local capture04 names refer to remote telemetry02.
A 113-bit residual evaluation of the unchanged double iterates at six and 120 iterations still fails the 2e-12 criterion; all 198 original records are preserved.
Unsigned loop-index subtraction wrapped in fixture data before conversion. The version02 signed-index fixture passes with writer code unchanged.

The initial author script used a wrong insertion literal and stopped on its assertion; the versioned script corrects that literal. The exception was observed in tool output but has no separately saved raw stderr artifact. Both scripts are retained; no invented stderr or native failure is claimed.
The first test invocation could not find the not-yet-created test file; zero tests ran. A separately named second result and independent run preserve the completed checks.
The read-only reviewer used CPU32; current-host admission rejected affinity outside the reserved controller CPUs. The same helper subsequently passed with the prescribed affinity.
The reviewer capture-magic assertion had one excess zero byte; its failed readback and helper are retained.
The reviewer expected worker.log instead of native-replay.log. The versioned final review uses the actual recorded filename.

The first Decimal comparison bound was smaller than documented long-double output rounding. A versioned reviewer fixture corrects that output bound; the diagnostic evaluator and 2e-12 scientific limit are unchanged.

scope: Scientific failures, pre-native/precompile control failures and author/reviewer mistakes are distinct. No unsuccessful record was replaced; intermediate unexecuted reader variants02/04 are retained as source, not reported as scientific runs.
